bull: Mar 2026 EBITDA margin held at 15.9% and PAT rose 24% YoY to INR364 cr.
Aug 2026 management reaffirmed sustained 15.6% EBITDA margin with Q1 FY27 reported at 15.6% margin.
Aug 2026 stated FY27/FY28 capex near INR850 crores; Mar 2026 fixed assets+CWIP grew sharply to INR2,105 cr.
bear: May 2026 guidance cut showed FY26 revenue slipped from INR4,500 cr to INR4,000 cr, ending at INR3,626 cr.
May 2026 FY26 PAT guidance implied worse margin; actual PAT was INR3,639 cr, margin 10.0%.
Mar 2026 cash flow deteriorated: CFO -INR600 cr, FCF -INR1,841 cr, fixed assets+CWIP INR2,105 cr.
